gloss: the far side; far away; beyond

definitions.gloss: far away; the far side; beyond
definitions.explanation: A place or point far off in space, or, figuratively, far back in time or memory. Often preceded by a word meaning "distant".

examples.japanese: ⟦{遥|はる}か→遥か：10388_haruka⟧{彼方|かなた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Mountains can be seen far in the distance.
I wonder what countries lie beyond the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧しまった。
examples.english: My childhood memories have already faded into the distant past.

notes:
Slightly literary; common in songs, stories, and descriptions of scenery. In everyday speech, ⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ is the usual word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遥|はる}か→遥か：10388_haruka⟧{彼方|かなた}: far, far away
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた}: beyond the sea
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた}: far off in the sky
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{彼方|かなた}: the distant reaches of memory

WATCH OUT:
The same kanji can also be read ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧ or ⟦あっち→あっち：02891_acchi⟧ (over there), but meaning "far away, beyond" it is read かなた, and it is often written in kana.
